lines.camp: You sit down with your back to a wall.
lines.leave: You get up and go on.
lines.nothing: Nothing to eat, and nobody to share it with.
lines.starving: You are starving. Every few steps costs you.
lines.ask: %s has come a long way with you. Are you sure?
lines.butchered: You send %s off ahead, and follow it round the corner with the knife. %d %s for the bag.
lines.no_room: Your bag has no room for what is left.
lines.fed: You hand %s a hot bowl. It eats everything, and it likes you better for it.
lines.found_out: %s stops chewing. It looks at the bowl, then at you. It knows. It walks out, and it will tell.
lines.witness: %s saw you come back alone, with the knife. It walks out, and it will tell.
lines.told: %s heard what you did. It keeps its distance now.
lines.sold: The trader sniffs the %s, doesn't ask, and pays %d gold. %d gold now.
lines.kept: Nobody ever asked what was in the stew.
lines.known: Everyone down here knows what was in the stew.
